plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.198-200. A course may be used to satisfy only one requirement within the major, as printed.

courses.title: Professional and Career Exploration course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these Professional and Career Exploration courses, 2 credits as printed: CLD 1100 Exploring Career & Life Directions; CLD 3100 Experiencing Career & Life Directions; ECM 3800 Internship; ____ 3800 Internship relevant to the major in another academic department.

courses.title: Historical and Formal Context courses (choose two)
courses.choice_note: Choose two of these Historical and Formal Context courses, 8 credits as printed: ECM 2110 Global Texts; ECM 2129 World Drama; ECM 3010 British Literature I; ECM 3020 British Literature II; ECM 3030 Early American Literature; ECM 3040 Modern American Literature; ECM 3100 Foreign Literature in Translation.

courses.title: Communication and Media courses (choose two)
courses.choice_note: Choose two of these Communication and Media courses, 8 credits as printed (students may only take one gaming course from this section): ECM 2170 Special Topics in Film; ECM 2310 Improving Conversation & Communication; ECM 2400 Media Writing & Ethics; ECM 2410 Student Publications Practicum (1-2 hours; may repeat to total 4 hours); ECM 2440 Successful Communication at Work; ECM 2450 Introduction to Creative Writing; ECM 2480 Screenwriting; ECM 2600 Media & Culture; ECM 2700 Media Production; ECM 2720 Podcasting; ECM 2830 Social Media & Reputation Management; ECM 2840 Sports & Media; ECM 3620 Special Topics: Communication & Media Studies; ECM 3720 Digital Videography; GAM 1200 Games & Play; GAM 1400 Exploring Game Design; GAM 2220 Games & Society; GAM 2230 Controversies in Gaming; GAM 2250 Game Storytelling and Narrative; GAM 2270 Game Journalism; GAM 2280 Game Studio (1-4 hours; may repeat to total 4 hours).

courses.title: Grammar / Communication course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: ECM 2300 Grammar and Linguistics; ECM 2310 Improving Conversation and Communication.

courses.title: Creativity and Innovation course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these Creativity and Innovation courses, 4 credits as printed: ECM 2400 Media Writing & Ethics; ECM 2410 Student Publications Practicum (1-2 hours; may repeat to total 4 hours); ECM 2450 Introduction to Creative Writing; ECM 2480 Screenwriting.

courses.title: Diversity and Difference course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these Diversity and Difference courses, 4 credits as printed: ECM 3519 African-American Writers; ECM 3529 Women Writers; ECM 3539 Writers of the American South; ECM 3559 Gender & Sexuality in Literature.

courses.title: ECM 2000+ Elective course
courses.choice_note: ECM 2000+ Elective, 4 credits as printed (block subtotal; no individual elective course is listed).
